info.title: Historical Weather APIs & Time-Series Analytics
info.description: Retrieve historical weather conditions for a single past date, with records available from 1940 through the present. Returns daily aggregate figures (temperature max/min/mean, precipitation, wind speed and gusts, cloud cover, humidity, pressure, dew point) by default, or 24 hourly readings for that date when `precision=hourly` is passed, plus sunrise/sunset/moon-phase astronomy data on every response. Accepts a location as a city name or address, GPS coordinates via `lat`/`long`, or an IP address; when none of these is supplied the API geolocates the requesting client's IP address instead. `latitude`, `longitude`, and `elevation` in the location object are always returned as strings, never numbers. This endpoint accepts only a single `date` per request --- use the Time-Series Weather API for continuous multi-date ranges.

get.summary: Retrieve historical weather conditions for a specific past date and location, coordinates, or IP address
get.description: Return daily aggregate or hourly weather readings plus astronomy data for a single past date going back to 1940, resolved by city/address, GPS coordinates, or IP address.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Specific date for which to fetch weather data in YYYY-MM-DD format. Historical dates must be past dates only. Current or future dates are not allowed for historical data. Data available from 1940 onwards.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City name, place name, or full address to look up historical weather for. Ignored when lat/long is provided.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the location. Takes precedence over location and ip when more than one location parameter is supplied.

parameters.name: long
parameters.description: Longitude of the location. Must be provided together with lat.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address for location inference. Ignored when location or lat/long is provided; if none of location, lat/long, or ip is supplied, the requesting client's IP address is used instead.

parameters.name: precision
parameters.description: Precision of the returned historical data. Possible values: daily (aggregated daily figures), hourly (24 hourly readings for the date). Default: daily.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone to render the astronomy time fields in, instead of the resolved location's own timezone. When set, sunrise/sunset/moonrise-type fields include the date (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM) instead of only HH:MM.

400.description: Bad Request --- Missing/invalid date, missing/incomplete lat+long pair, coordinates out of range, invalid IP address, invalid precision, or invalid timezone

MissingRequiredParams.summary: Missing date, or lat given without long

value.message: date must be in yyyy-mm-dd format

FutureOrCurrentDate.summary: Date is today or in the future

value.message: date cannot be current or future date
Parameter 'startDate' is out of allowed range from 1940-01-01 to 2026-07-24

InvalidCoordinates.summary: Latitude or longitude out of range

value.message: Invalid latitude or longitude values. Latitude must be between -90 and 90, and longitude must be between -180 and 180
Check whether your input value is correct; timezone = NotATimezone

404.description: Not Found --- Location could not be resolved

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

HistoricalResponse.description: Historical weather response containing location data and historical weather data for the requested date.

WeatherLocation.description: Location information. The shape of this object varies by lookup method.

oneOf.description: Location data when the target is specified by GPS coordinates (lat/long).
Location data when the target is inferred from an IP address.
Location data when the target is specified by a city name or address string.

LocationByCoordinates.description: Location data when the target is specified by GPS coordinates (lat/long). country_name, state_prov, and city are omitted when the coordinates do not resolve to any political boundary (e.g. open ocean).

latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees, ranging from -90 (South Pole) to +90 (North Pole). Returned as a string, not a number.

longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees, ranging from -180 (West) to +180 (East). Returned as a string, not a number.

country_name.description: Full name of the country corresponding to the provided coordinates.

state_prov.description: State, province, or primary administrative division name for the location.

city.description: City or municipal area name associated with the coordinate location.

locality.description: Specific locality, neighborhood, district, or village name within the broader area.

elevation.description: Height above mean sea level in meters for the specified coordinates. Returned as a string, not a number; can be an empty string when unavailable.

timezone.description: IANA timezone database identifier for the location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London).

timezone_abbreviation.description: Abbreviated timezone representation based on current offset (e.g., EST, GMT, PST).

LocationByIP.description: Location data when the target is inferred from an IP address.

continent_code.description: Two-letter continent code (e.g., NA for North America, EU for Europe, AS for Asia).

continent_name.description: Full name of the continent where the IP address is registered.

country_code2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two-letter country code (e.g., US, GB, FR).

country_code3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code (e.g., USA, GBR, FRA).

country_name.description: Common name of the country associated with the IP address.

country_name_official.description: Official long-form country name as recognized internationally (e.g., United States of America).

is_eu.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the country is a member state of the European Union.

state_prov.description: State, province, or primary administrative division associated with the IP location.

state_code.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code for the state or province (e.g., CA for California).

district.description: District, county, or secondary administrative division within the region.

city.description: City or urban area name where the IP address is geographically registered.

zipcode.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the approximate location of the IP address.

latitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for the IP geolocation, ranging from -90 to +90. Returned as a string, not a number.

longitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for the IP geolocation, ranging from -180 to +180. Returned as a string, not a number.

locality.description: Specific locality, neighborhood, or small area designation within the city.

elevation.description: Elevation above mean sea level in meters for the IP geolocation. Returned as a string, not a number; can be an empty string when unavailable.

timezone.description: IANA timezone database identifier for the IP location (e.g., America/Chicago, Asia/Tokyo).

timezone_abbreviation.description: Current timezone abbreviation based on local offset (e.g., CST, JST, UTC).

LocationByAddress.description: Location data when the target is specified by a city name or address string.

location_string.description: Original location query string as submitted, including full address or place name.

country_name.description: Resolved country name derived from the geocoded location query.

state_prov.description: State, province, or primary administrative division identified from the location.

city.description: City or municipal area name extracted from the geocoded location.

locality.description: Specific locality, neighborhood, suburb, or village within the geocoded area.

latitude.description: Geocoded latitude coordinate in decimal degrees, ranging from -90 to +90. Returned as a string, not a number.

longitude.description: Geocoded longitude coordinate in decimal degrees, ranging from -180 to +180. Returned as a string, not a number.

elevation.description: Elevation above mean sea level in meters at the geocoded coordinates. Returned as a string, not a number; can be an empty string when unavailable.

timezone.description: IANA timezone database identifier for the geocoded location (e.g., America/Los_Angeles).

timezone_abbreviation.description: Current timezone abbreviation for the location based on local offset (e.g., PDT, CET).

HistoricalData.description: Historical weather data for the requested date, containing an astronomy block plus one of daily or hourly readings depending on the precision parameter. It is not keyed by date --- each request covers exactly one date.

daily.description: Daily aggregate weather data for the requested day. Present when precision is daily (the default).

hourly.description: Hourly weather readings for the requested day, one entry per hour (24 entries). Present when precision is hourly.

astronomy.description: Astronomical data for the requested day. Always present regardless of precision.

HistoricalDaily.description: Daily historical weather summary with temperature, precipitation, wind, and radiation statistics.

timestamp.description: The requested date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

weather_code.description: WMO weather condition code representing the day's dominant conditions. Supported codes: 0 clear sky; 1, 2, 3 varying cloud cover; 45, 48 fog; 51, 53, 55 drizzle; 56, 57 freezing drizzle; 61, 63, 65 rain; 66, 67 freezing rain; 71, 73, 75 snowfall; 77 snow grains; 80, 81, 82 rain showers; 85, 86 snow showers; 95 thunderstorm; 96, 99 thunderstorm with hail.

temperature_2m_mean.description: Daily mean air temperature at 2 meters (°C).

temperature_2m_max.description: Daily maximum air temperature at 2 meters (°C).

temperature_2m_min.description: Daily minimum air temperature at 2 meters (°C).

wind_speed_10m_mean.description: Daily mean wind speed at 10 meters (km/h).

wind_gusts_10m_mean.description: Daily mean wind gusts at 10 meters (km/h).

shortwave_radiation_sum.description: Daily sum of shortwave solar radiation (MJ/m²).

dew_point_2m_mean.description: Daily mean dew point temperature at 2 meters (°C).

dew_point_2m_max.description: Daily maximum dew point temperature at 2 meters (°C).

dew_point_2m_min.description: Daily minimum dew point temperature at 2 meters (°C).

relative_humidity_2m_mean.description: Daily mean relative humidity at 2 meters (%).

relative_humidity_2m_max.description: Daily maximum relative humidity at 2 meters (%).

relative_humidity_2m_min.description: Daily minimum relative humidity at 2 meters (%).

pressure_msl_mean.description: Daily mean atmospheric pressure at mean sea level (hPa).

surface_pressure_mean.description: Daily mean surface pressure at ground level (hPa).

HistoricalHourly.description: Hourly historical weather reading with temperature, precipitation, and wind data.

timestamp.description: Local timestamp for this hourly reading, in `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` format — not full ISO 8601 (no seconds, no timezone offset/`Z`).

weather_code.description: WMO weather condition code representing conditions during this hour. Supported codes: 0 clear sky; 1, 2, 3 varying cloud cover; 45, 48 fog; 51, 53, 55 drizzle; 56, 57 freezing drizzle; 61, 63, 65 rain; 66, 67 freezing rain; 71, 73, 75 snowfall; 77 snow grains; 80, 81, 82 rain showers; 85, 86 snow showers; 95 thunderstorm; 96, 99 thunderstorm with hail.

pressure_msl.description: Atmospheric pressure at mean sea level (hPa).

albedo.description: Reflectivity of the Earth's surface. Currently always returned as null.

global_tilted_irradiance.description: Total solar irradiance on a tilted surface (W/m²).

Astronomy.description: Astronomical data including sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length, moon phase, and moon times. Time fields are HH:MM by default; when the timezone query parameter is set, they include the date as well (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM).

date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format for the astronomical data.

mid_night.description: Time of true solar midnight in HH:MM format.

night_end.description: Time when astronomical twilight ends and dawn begins in HH:MM format.

sunrise.description: Time when the Sun becomes visible above the horizon in HH:MM format.

solar_noon.description: Time when the Sun reaches its highest point in the sky in HH:MM format.

sunset.description: Time when the Sun disappears below the horizon in HH:MM format.

night_begin.description: Time when astronomical twilight begins and night starts in HH:MM format.

day_length.description: Total duration of daylight in HH:MM format.

sun_status.description: Current position of the Sun relative to the horizon (above_horizon, below_horizon, or -).

moon_phase.description: Current lunar phase (NEW_MOON, WAXING_CRESCENT, FULL_MOON, WANING_GIBBOUS, etc.).

moonrise.description: Time when the Moon becomes visible above the horizon in HH:MM format.

moonset.description: Time when the Moon disappears below the horizon in HH:MM format.

moon_status.description: Current visibility status of the Moon (visible, not_visible, or -).

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
